title: Failed-Sale Charge Billing Card — Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
When a Real Estate Service Contracts listing order ends without a closing, Bridgewell bills the seller one failed-sale charge for the listing-period service it provided.

## When a failed-sale charge is billed

- A failed-sale charge is billed only on an order in status listing expired or cancelled that never recorded a closing.
- Only one failed-sale charge is billed per order.
- A buyer-only order never carries one.
- The charge is due the plan's failed-sale charge payment period, in calendar days, after the billing date, so its due date is the billing date plus that number of calendar days.

| Order | Under this rule |
|---|---|
| Listing order, listing expired, no closing ever recorded, no failed-sale charge yet | within the orders on which a failed-sale charge is billed |
| Listing order, cancelled, no closing ever recorded, no failed-sale charge yet | within the orders on which a failed-sale charge is billed |
| Listing order that already carries a failed-sale charge | no further charge |
| Buyer-only order | never a failed-sale charge |

## Invocation: `bill_failed_sale_charge_3e9b31c4`

**Capability.** One call posts one failed-sale charge invoice to the plan's billing history in the name of the seller who held the listing order, dated today, for the amount and due date given, and raises the plan's invoice balance by that amount. A new failed-sale invoice number is issued for the charge and returned in the receipt. The charge then shows in the plan's billing history as an open failed-sale charge. The tool books the values it is given exactly; it checks no eligibility, order or status itself.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `bill_failed_sale_charge_3e9b31c4` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `realty_contract_id` | the real estate contract (plan) number of the listing order being billed, as shown by the real estate contract lookup for the seller | identifier text |
| `amount` | the failed-sale charge to bill | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent; booked exactly as given |
| `due_date` | the date by which the seller must pay the charge | YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date with no time of day |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries: `status` "billed" when the charge was posted; `invoice_number`, the new failed-sale invoice number (text); `realty_contract_id`, the plan number billed; `amount`, the charge booked in USD with 2 decimal places; `entry_date`, today's billing date as YYYY-MM-DD; `due_date`, the payment due date as YYYY-MM-DD; `invoice_balance`, the plan's invoice balance after the charge in USD with 2 decimal places.

**Hypothetical input and receipt.** A call with `realty_contract_id` "RC-0001", `amount` 412.50 and a `due_date` returns `status` "billed", a new `invoice_number`, `amount` 412.50 and the `invoice_balance` raised by 412.50.
